purpose: Candidate specialist skills for LawFirm-os-intake source grounding, labor and employment role mapping, budget-driver context review, and carrier rejection learning-loop review.

skills.description: Source-bound review of intake inventories, attachments, passage refs, claim refs, hashes, prompt-injection boundaries, and missing coverage before downstream reliance.
Candidate L&E entity, role, and relationship mapping with unknown states and evidence refs; no conflict conclusion or canonical taxonomy.
Candidate review of whether source-bound L&E context supports, widens, or blocks a budget proposal based on budget-driver evidence and missing facts.
Candidate review of carrier rejection, appeal result, financial outcome, and learning-loop evidence; no portal write, appeal submission, or automatic learning.

approval_note: These skills are deliberately draft candidates. Run malicious-skill-review, skill evaluation, trust-surface review, and control-plane governance before approval or installation.
